game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must hold off ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against ice wolves.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against ice wolves. Then check spells and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hold gate from ice wolves in Frozen Gatehouse: keep spells above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 1, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
